title: Implement Emergency section variant (emergency-callout)
description: Implement an Emergency/24-7 Service section with a prominent phone number callout. Suitable for emergency plumbers, roofers, locksmiths, etc.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ content: EmergencyContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Renders headline, large clickable phone number, availability text, optional services list
Phone number is styled prominently and is a `tel:` link
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: High-contrast section (use `--color-primary` or bold accent background). Large headline. Extra-large phone number as `<a href='tel:...'>` with bell/phone icon. Availability text (e.g., '24/7 Emergency Service'). Services list as badges if present. Bold, urgent visual design.
Take Playwright screenshot. Confirm phone number is large and prominent.
